goal: Implement the smallest formal feature-unit planning increment: one explicit operation becomes one frozen typed feature contract, independent owned leaves can run concurrently, and unrequested architecture is deleted from short-task plans.
acceptance_criteria: An explicit single-operation Python CLI goal produces one canonical feature contract with one public entrypoint, exact typed inputs and output, declared errors and side effects, acceptance behaviors, owned paths, and no invented business capabilities.

Each Provider source request contains only one feature leaf plus its frozen contract and direct dependency interfaces; a rejected leaf is repaired independently without regenerating accepted unrelated leaves.

Explicit negative scope such as no persistence, networking, frameworks, or unrelated features prevents repository, service, database, generic workflow, orchestrator, and pipeline outputs from entering the canonical plan.

Minimal feature projects retain only necessary packaging, source, focused tests, and requested documentation while using the unchanged Provider validation, post-build, local_packager, public-delivery, and delivery-manifest route.
Planning, provider, kernel, and end-to-end regression tests prove the former one-function goal no longer expands into generic repository/service workflows.
The canonical plan freezes shared interfaces before generation and groups dependency-ready feature leaves into parallel batches only when their owned paths do not conflict.

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

feedback: The single-feature contract, API leaf boundary, bounded semantic review, exact project-local output, and focused generated-project tests passed. Formal delivery remains NOT_EVALUATED because Agent Kit generation did not request package/delivery.

worked: Frozen typed interfaces plus exact owned paths kept the generated project to nine planned files and enabled one-leaf repair.
The Qwen semantic review completed at 9,990 prompt characters, 1,800 output tokens, and reasoning effort none with zero transport failures.
did_not_work: Bare __init__.py guidance initially drifted from its package-qualified planned path until unique-basename binding was added.
The first API candidate added an undeclared TypeError; API leaf validation exposed and repaired it before write.
experiments: For future independent multi-feature acceptance, compare conflict-free parallel batches against sequential leaves using provider requests, prompt characters, repair closure size, and wall time.
